answer: Draw a marble for every key each epoch: one draw in twenty sends a falcon auditor that re-runs that key's task live under a 60-second deadline and compares the output. A failed audit burns the key's 250 POA bond and flags every key funded from the same wallet, whose audit odds jump to one in two. A farm of N keys on one funder becomes a reef that sinks together: the chance of a first catch climbs toward certainty as N grows, and one catch exposes the whole cluster, while a lone honest key just passes a cheap 5% check.
